name: agent-stack
description: Production patterns for building agent orchestrators — and for billing the LLM access they burn.

plugins.name: agent-stack
plugins.description: Two skills: agent-orchestrator — tool-calling loops, multi-stage pipelines with checkpoints, provider routing with fallback, four-layer memory, context engineering, plus the wallet side of reselling LLM access; and agent-evals — run/trace/thread evals, judges, and fixtures grown from production.
